name: spec-drift-mngr
description: Drift control between a project's business-rule ledger and its code: a reconciliation gate before work starts and a wrap-up gate before a branch is finished.

interface.shortDescription: Keeps a project's business-rule ledger pinned to its code with a pre-work reconciliation gate and a pre-merge wrap-up gate.
interface.longDescription: Spec Drift Manager ships one skill, spec-drift, that keeps a project's business-rule ledger -- a set of falsifiable assertions anchored to code symbols -- from drifting away from the code it describes. Gate 1 runs a reconciliation before work on a requirement starts: read the ledger, predict what will change, and get the owner's nod. Gate 2 runs a wrap-up ritual before a branch merges: reconcile what actually changed against the prediction, and update the ledger in the same batch as the code. The mechanism does not guarantee the ledger is always right -- it guarantees that once the ledger and the code come apart, the alarm goes off at the wrap-up of the next change.
